process.title: Process & Pricing
process.overviewText: Everything that usually takes a long DM thread — how I work, what it costs, and whether we're a match. If it reads right, send a request; I answer within 48 hours.
process.goodFitText:
I make original, medium-to-large tattoos in a painterly style rooted in Japanese and Chinese art and calligraphy, with a contemporary edge. Your references set the direction — the design itself is always mine, created for you and no one else.

If you're looking for fine line, lettering, a very small tattoo, or an exact copy of an existing piece, an artist who specializes in that will be a better match — and I'll say so up front.
process.pricingText: ₪1,000 per hour, with a ₪2,000 minimum. Placement and complexity don't change the rate — they change how much time the work takes, and time is what you pay for.
process.bookingText: Want to talk it through first? Consultations are free, in person, no deposit needed. When we agree to go ahead, we book your session and take a ₪1,000 deposit — this locks in the date and starts the sketch. It isn't an extra charge: the full amount counts toward your tattoo. The deposit is non-refundable; one date change is free, and it moves with you. After a no-show or a second change, booking again takes a fresh one. Bigger projects: work over several sessions is paid session by session — and no second deposit: the one you've already paid moves with the project and counts toward the final sitting.
process.designText:
Your sketch is built on what we've agreed — idea, references, placement — interpreted in my style. It reaches you the day before the session, and small refinements happen at the appointment itself.

The sketch itself costs nothing extra. But a complete redo is new work: the deposit pays for the first version, and starting over takes a new one. Trust your artist! 🖤
process.touchUpsText: Free within 3 months of your session. Later than that, they're priced by time, like any other work.
process.ageText: You must be 18 or older to book through this site. At 16–17, tattooing is possible only with a parent's written consent and presence — message me on Instagram and we'll arrange it properly.
process.languagesText: Sessions run in Hebrew, English, or Russian — whichever is comfortable.
process.paymentText: The deposit is the only advance payment; the rest is due after each session — cash, Bit, or bank transfer.

faqItems.a: Yes, the sketch is included when you book. Only a complete concept change needs a new deposit (see Design & Sketch above).

faqItems.q: What if I change my idea?
faqItems.a: Small adjustments are part of the process. A completely new direction means a new sketch and a new deposit.
Yes. A cover-up is priced like any other piece — by the time it needs. Include a photo of the existing tattoo in your request.

faqItems.q: Can a large tattoo be split into sessions?
faqItems.a: Yes, that's normal for big work. You pay per session; the deposit stays with the project until the final sitting.
Depends on placement and how long we work — some spots are easy, some less so. Breaks are always fine, and we'll pace the session together.

faqItems.q: I only have a rough idea — is that enough?
faqItems.a: Yes. A feeling, a theme, a few references — that's plenty. Turning it into a design is my job.

faqItems.q: How do I prepare — and what about healing?
faqItems.a: Each has its own short guide: <prep>Preparation</prep> for before the session, <aftercare>Aftercare</aftercare> for after.

preparation.title: Before Your Appointment
preparation.intro: For clients with an upcoming appointment — here's how to prepare and what to expect on the day.
preparation.beforeAppointmentItems:
Get a good night of sleep
Eat a proper meal before you arrive
Avoid alcohol the day before
Wear comfortable clothes that make the tattoo area easy to access
If needed, shave the area in advance (or I can help at the studio)
preparation.tattooDayItems:
Bring a valid ID
We confirm size and placement together
I prepare the stencil and transfer it until you're happy with the placement
Please try to stay still during the session (tell me if you need a break)
After the tattoo, we'll take photos, then I'll apply aftercare protection and explain next steps

aftercare.title: Aftercare
aftercare.intro: Your tattoo is done — here's how to care for it while it heals.
aftercare.aftercareInstructionsItems:
You'll leave with a protective film (Second Skin)
Keep it on for 3–7 days (minimum 3 days)
After removal: wash gently with warm water
Apply a thin layer of unscented moisturizer (e.g. Bepanthen Plus, or similar)
Keep the area clean and dry
Avoid soaking (sea, pool, hot springs) for at least 3 weeks
Avoid direct sunlight; use sunscreen once fully healed
Do not scratch or pick flaking skin (pat gently if itchy)
aftercare.healingTouchUpsItems:
Healing time varies: small tattoos may take ~2 weeks, larger pieces longer
If you notice unusual redness, heat, swelling, or persistent bleeding, contact a doctor
Touch-ups are free within 3 months after your tattoo
After 3 months, touch-ups are charged depending on what's needed

request.title: Request a Tattoo
request.introduction: This form replaces a long back-and-forth in my DMs and keeps everything about your idea in one place. You don't need to have every detail figured out — share what you know, and I'll reply within 48 hours.
request.ideaDescriptionPlaceholder: Tell me about your tattoo idea — style, motif, mood, anything that inspires you
request.placementHint: Where on your body do you want it?
request.uploadFormatsHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC/HEIF · max 4 MB per image

uploads.artistWorkBenefit: Seen something of mine you love? It tells me exactly which direction speaks to you.
uploads.inspirationBenefit: Mood boards welcome — I use them for direction and mood, never for copying another artist's work.
uploads.placementPhotoBenefit: A quick photo of the area helps me judge size and flow on your body before I reply.
uploads.maxFilesWarning: You can upload up to {maxFiles} images per category.

request.budgetHint: Helps me understand your expectations. Not binding.
